DEINE ROLLE

Als Executive Assistant unterstützt du unsere Geschäftsführung bzw. Den CEO direkt im operativen Alltag. Du steuerst seinen Kalender, bereitest Meetings vor und nach und bist eine zentrale Drehscheibe für die interne Kommunikation und Koordination.

Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, tiefgehende Einblicke in das Management eines der innovativsten Scale-Ups im Bereich Financial Services zu gewinnen und den Arbeitsalltag unseres CEOs unmittelbar mitzugestalten. Aufgrund der Nähe zum Senior Management ist eine hohe Präsenz im Berliner Büro Voraussetzung.

Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Kalender- & Terminmanagement: Du steuerst und priorisierst den Kalender unseres CEOs, koordinierst Termine über verschiedene Stakeholder hinweg und organisierst nach Bedarf Reisen sowie deren Vor- und Nachbereitung.

  • Meeting-Vorbereitung & -Nachbereitung: Du bereitest Meetings des Management Teams organisatorisch vor, erstellst Agenden und Unterlagen, hältst Ergebnisse und To-dos fest und sorgst für ein konsequentes Follow-up.

  • Externe Kommunikation: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für externe Partner & Investoren und bereitest für den CEO die quartärlichen Board Meetings koordinativ sowie inhaltlich vor und nach.

  • Interne Kommunikation & Koordination: Du bist eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unserem CEO and den Teams, sorgst für einen reibungslosen Informationsfluss und stellst sicher, dass Anfragen zeitnah und zuverlässig bearbeitet werden.

  • Interne Organisation: Du übernimmst die organisatorische & inhaltliche Vorbereitung von All-Hands, Team-Events, Offsites und Formaten rund um das CEO Office und behältst dabei stets den Überblick über parallele Themen.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Executive Assistant, im Assistenz- oder Office-Management, idealerweise im direkten Umfeld von Senior Management in einem dynamischen Umfeld wie einem Scale-Up, einer Beratung oder einem vergleichbaren Kontext.

  • Organisationstalent: Ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Prioritäten, exzellentes Zeitmanagement und die Fähigkeit, auch bei vielen parallelen Themen den Überblick zu behalten.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in schriftlicher und mündlicher Kommunikation auf deutschsprachigem Muttersprachniveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Diskretion & Verlässlichkeit: Ein hohes Maß an Vertraulichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Verbindlichkeit im Umgang mit sensiblen Themen.

  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Eigeninitiative, eine proaktive Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, in einem dynamischen Umfeld schnell pragmatische Lösungen zu finden.

Über uns

Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Unsere Mission ist es, gleiche Bedingungen für wohlhabende Anlegerinnen und Anleger zu schaffen, indem wir ihnen Zugang zu Expertise und Anlagelösungen ermöglichen, die ihnen bisher verschlossen waren. title: Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders)
description: Your Mission: We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders) to help us design and develop the mechanical systems on board our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will contribute to the definition and development of key aircraft mechanical systems, including the Environmental Control System, landing gear, ice protection, interiors and other mechanical systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, propulsion and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft. Your Day-to-Day: Define and derive system-level requirements for mechanical aircraft systems based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations. Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces. Contribute to the definition and development of mechanical systems to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase. Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between mechanical systems and other aircraft disciplines. Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for mechanical systems. Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements. Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities. Your Profile: Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent. 8+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft mechanical systems. Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration. Knowledge and experience in mechanical aircraft systems, preferably cabin Environmental Control System and/or landing gear. Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification. Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus. Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment. Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight. Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems. Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme. raw.description:

We are looking for a Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer (all genders) to help us design and develop the mechanical systems on board our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, propulsion and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

  • Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

  • Contribute to the definition and development of mechanical systems to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

  • Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between mechanical systems and other aircraft disciplines.

  • Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for mechanical systems.

  • Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

  • Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

 

Your Profile:

  • Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

  • 8+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft mechanical systems.

  • Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

  • Knowledge and experience in mechanical aircraft systems, preferably cabin Environmental Control System and/or landing gear.

  • Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

  • Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

title: Content Creator & Social Media Manager (m/w/d) – Fußball Amateur- & Profisport
description: Mach Vereinsgeschichten sichtbar Du fühlst Dich auf dem Sportplatz wohl, gehst gerne auf Menschen zu und hast Ideen für Videos, die man sich bis zum Ende anschaut? Du stehst selbst gerne vor der Kamera und kannst Deine Inhalte eigenständig drehen und schneiden? Wir bei stickerfive entwickeln und produzieren individuelle Stickeralben für den Amateur- und Profisport sowie für Unternehmen und besondere Themenwelten. Bei uns bekommen Vereinsmitglieder ihren eigenen Sticker, Fans sammeln ihre Mannschaft und am Spielfeldrand wird getauscht. Dahinter stecken Geschichten, die wir auf Social Media bisher viel zu selten erzählen. Unsere Kanäle und unsere Reichweite möchten wir deshalb gezielt ausbauen. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der diesen Bereich mit eigenen Ideen und praktischer Erfahrung voranbringt. Deine Aufgaben Content entwickeln und produzieren: Du setzt Ideen für Reels, TikToks und Stories um. Vom Konzept über den Dreh bis zum Schnitt und zur Veröffentlichung begleitest Du Deine Inhalte selbst. Vor der Kamera stehen: Du stellst unsere Sammelaktionen vor, führst kurze Interviews und gibst Einblicke in den Alltag bei stickerfive. Vereine begleiten: Du besuchst Fotoshootings, Verkaufsstarts und Tauschbörsen. Dabei fängst Du die Stimmung ein und kommst mit den Menschen vor Ort ins Gespräch. Unsere Kanäle betreuen: Du entwickelst einen Redaktionsplan, veröffentlichst regelmäßig und kümmerst Dich um Kommentare und Nachrichten. Reichweite und Community aufbauen: Du entwickelst wiederkehrende Formate und Inhalte, die Menschen gerne anschauen, teilen und kommentieren. Passende Trends greifst Du auf und übersetzt sie in Ideen für stickerfive. Ergebnisse auswerten: Du schaust Dir an, welche Inhalte funktionieren, und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab. Dabei interessieren Dich beispielsweise Wiedergabedauer, geteilte Beiträge und die Entwicklung unserer Community. Drehs und Inhalte organisieren: Du stimmst Dich mit unseren Vereinen sowie mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb ab. Du planst Termine und kümmerst Dich rechtzeitig um die Informationen und Materialien, die Du benötigst. Was du mitbringst Du hast bereits selbst Social-Media-Inhalte produziert und kannst uns konkrete Beispiele zeigen. Ob für ein Unternehmen, einen Verein oder Deinen eigenen Kanal, ist dabei zweitrangig. Uns interessiert, was Du selbst umgesetzt hast und was Du daraus gelernt hast. Außerdem wünschen wir uns: Interesse am Sport, besonders am Amateur- und Vereinsleben. Vielleicht bist Du selbst im Verein aktiv oder begleitest schon eine Mannschaft mit der Kamera. Freude daran, vor der Kamera zu sprechen und auch auf fremde Menschen offen zuzugehen. Einen sicheren Umgang mit Smartphone oder Kamera und einem Schnittprogramm wie CapCut, Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve. Ein Gespür für gute Einstiege, verständliche Geschichten und das passende Tempo eines Videos. Gute deutsche Ausdrucksfähigkeit, sowohl beim Sprechen als auch beim Schreiben. Eine selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise. Du bringst Ideen ein, organisierst deren Umsetzung und sprichst offene Fragen oder Hindernisse frühzeitig an. Bereitschaft zu Drehs bei unseren Partnervereinen, in der Regel am Wochenende. Eine bestimmte Ausbildung oder ein Studium setzen wir nicht voraus. Deine Arbeitsproben und Deine Fähigkeiten zählen. Eine große eigene Followerschaft brauchst Du ebenfalls nicht. Erfahrung mit bezahlter Werbung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Du hast bereits mit Meta Ads oder TikTok Ads gearbeitet und Kampagnen zur Gewinnung neuer Interessenten betreut? Dann kannst Du diese Erfahrung bei uns einbringen und je nach Kenntnisstand auch Kampagnen übernehmen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf Content und dem Aufbau unserer Social-Media-Kanäle. Dein Gestaltungsspielraum Unser Social-Media-Auftritt (Facebook & Instagram) ist ziemlich mau. Auf TikTok sind wir noch nicht aktiv. Du kannst deshalb von Beginn an mitprägen, wie stickerfive auftritt. Vielleicht begleitest Du eine Mannschaft, die zum ersten Mal ihr eigenes Album sieht. Vielleicht entwickelst Du ein Interviewformat am Spielfeldrand oder zeigst, wie aus einem Mannschaftsfoto ein Sticker wird. Wir suchen jemanden, der solche Ideen mitbringt und sie umsetzt. Gemeinsam legen wir Ziele und Prioritäten fest. Du bekommst Raum, neue Formate auszuprobieren, und arbeitest eng mit den Menschen zusammen, die unsere Sammelprojekte betreuen. Das erwartet Dich bei uns Geschichten direkt aus dem Sport: Du lernst Amateurvereine kennen und erhältst Einblicke in unsere Projekte mit dem Profisport. Kreativer Freiraum: Du entwickelst eigene Formate und prägst den Auftritt von stickerfive mit. Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Du arbeitest direkt mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb zusammen. Abwechslung zwischen Büro und Sportplatz: Dein Arbeitsplatz ist in Gräfelfing bei München. Wie oft Du wirklich am Ende vor Ort in Gräfelfing bei München oder im Homeoffice bist, kommt auf Deinen Wohnort an. Für Drehs bist Du auch bei unseren Partnervereinen unterwegs. Ausstattung und Flexibilität: Du erhältst ein Firmenhandy und bei Bedarf auch einen Firmenlaptop. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten stimmen wir passend zu Drehs und Teamterminen ab. Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Ob Stadionbesuch oder Wiesn, auch außerhalb unserer Projekte unternehmen wir etwas zusammen. Extras im Arbeitsalltag: Kostenlose Getränke und Kaffee sowie Mitarbeiterrabatte gehören ebenfalls dazu. Zeig uns, was Du machst Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder einen kurzen Überblick über Deinen bisherigen Weg sowie Arbeitsproben. Besonders interessieren uns Videos, die Du selbst konzipiert, gedreht oder geschnitten hast. Bei gemeinsamen Projekten schreib bitte kurz dazu, welche Aufgaben Du übernommen hast. Mindestens eines der Beispiele sollte Dich vor der Kamera zeigen. Falls Du dazu noch nichts Passendes hast, reicht auch ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo mit dem Smartphone. Erzähl uns außerdem, welchen Bezug Du zum Sport hast, wann Du anfangen könntest und welchen Stundenumfang und welches Gehalt Du Dir vorstellst. Bewirb Dich direkt hier über die Plattform oder kontaktiere uns über unsere Kanäle Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Unser Social-Media-Auftritt (Facebook & Instagram) ist ziemlich mau. Auf TikTok sind wir noch nicht aktiv. Du kannst deshalb von Beginn an mitprägen, wie stickerfive auftritt.

Vielleicht begleitest Du eine Mannschaft, die zum ersten Mal ihr eigenes Album sieht. Vielleicht entwickelst Du ein Interviewformat am Spielfeldrand oder zeigst, wie aus einem Mannschaftsfoto ein Sticker wird. Wir suchen jemanden, der solche Ideen mitbringt und sie umsetzt.

Gemeinsam legen wir Ziele und Prioritäten fest. Du bekommst Raum, neue Formate auszuprobieren, und arbeitest eng mit den Menschen zusammen, die unsere Sammelprojekte betreuen.

Das erwartet Dich bei uns

  • Geschichten direkt aus dem Sport: Du lernst Amateurvereine kennen und erhältst Einblicke in unsere Projekte mit dem Profisport.

  • Kreativer Freiraum: Du entwickelst eigene Formate und prägst den Auftritt von stickerfive mit.

  • Ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen: Du arbeitest direkt mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb zusammen.

  • Abwechslung zwischen Büro und Sportplatz: Dein Arbeitsplatz ist in Gräfelfing bei München. Wie oft Du wirklich am Ende vor Ort in Gräfelfing bei München oder im Homeoffice bist, kommt auf Deinen Wohnort an. Für Drehs bist Du auch bei unseren Partnervereinen unterwegs.

  • Gemeinsame Erlebnisse: Ob Stadionbesuch oder Wiesn, auch außerhalb unserer Projekte unternehmen wir etwas zusammen.

  • Extras im Arbeitsalltag: Kostenlose Getränke und Kaffee sowie Mitarbeiterrabatte gehören ebenfalls dazu.

Zeig uns, was Du machst

Schick uns Deinen Lebenslauf oder einen kurzen Überblick über Deinen bisherigen Weg sowie Arbeitsproben. Besonders interessieren uns Videos, die Du selbst konzipiert, gedreht oder geschnitten hast. Bei gemeinsamen Projekten schreib bitte kurz dazu, welche Aufgaben Du übernommen hast.

Mindestens eines der Beispiele sollte Dich vor der Kamera zeigen. Falls Du dazu noch nichts Passendes hast, reicht auch ein kurzes Vorstellungsvideo mit dem Smartphone.

Erzähl uns außerdem, welchen Bezug Du zum Sport hast, wann Du anfangen könntest und welchen Stundenumfang und welches Gehalt Du Dir vorstellst.

We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. You'll be the directly responsible individual (DRI) on your own projects from scoping through postmortem, collaborating closely with product, design, legal, support, and leadership. Media relations experience, including pitching journalists, handling inquiries, and building press relationships. Experience measuring social media and earned media reach, engagement, sentiment, and campaign impact and turning results into insightful reports. Hybrid in London or remote in the UK

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Credit Risk Modelling team.

You'll shape how iwoca models credit risk – setting the technical direction on multi-quarter projects, and lifting the bar for the team as you go.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Credit Risk Modelling team owns credit risk and Customer Lifetime Value (CLtV) modelling for iwoca's UK and German lending. That covers the probabilistic machine learning models behind every credit decision, plus the CLtV models that shape pricing and portfolio strategy.

The team is around twelve data scientists. Some work on auto-space models that decide within five minutes from data candidates authorise us to pull. Others work on manual-space models that pick up when a credit analyst adds digital footprint and income data, which lands a decision within 24 hours.

The role

You'll own credit and CLtV modelling projects end to end, from spotting where the modelling stack is holding the business back through to landing the change. The work spans keeping production models healthy, incremental development, and research that reshapes how the models work. AI has lowered the cost of prototyping enough that ideas which used to sit below the priority line are now viable, so the R&D share of the role is growing.

Live examples of the work:

  • Causal estimation of offer terms. Modelling how amount, duration, and price shape customer outcomes.

  • Unifying auto and manual models. The two families were built without forced technical alignment. Finding a principled way to unify them on a common cost function is open work.

  • IFRS accounting model. A multi-stage credit model where information propagates back from later-stage recovery predictions to sharpen upfront loss estimates.

  • Generalising credit and CLtV. Whether a more general framing could replace both separate models is an open research question.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

  • Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns.

  • Production ML. You have built and shipped supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, monitoring.

  • Research mindset. You proactively explore new ways to add value. R&D time is when you expect to find the next step change.

  • Judgement. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. You defend your reasoning under challenge, and challenge others' when the evidence points elsewhere. You've influenced technical direction beyond your own projects.

  • Project leadership. You've owned modelling projects end to end, from spotting the opportunity through framing, method choice, shipping, and landing the commercial impact. You move fast, iterate, and update on new evidence rather than chase perfection.

  • AI fluency. You use AI as a primary tool. You prototype with it, automate with it, and take on R&D that would not otherwise be viable. You use judgement on where it helps and where it doesn't.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling.

  • Non-linear methods. You have shipped gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production.

  • Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Time series modelling. You have modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered.

  • Python. The stack the team uses.

The salary

We expect to pay from £90,000 – £120,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation: £90K – £120K

  • Analytical ownership. You take ambiguous problems end to end, from framing to a landed decision. You like to move fast, iterate, and update on new evidence rather than chase perfection.

  • AI fluency. You use AI as a primary tool. You prototype with it, automate with it, and take on R&D that would not otherwise be viable. You use judgement on where it helps and where it doesn't.

Bonus:

  • Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk, lending, or customer lifetime value modelling.

  • Production ML. You have built and shipped supervised ML models end to end – exploration, training, deployment, monitoring.

  • Non-linear methods. You can think in terms of the cost function and inductive biases of your models

  • Bayesian methods. You have used hierarchical models, MCMC, or Bayesian updating in real work.

  • Time series modelling. You have modelled temporal data where autocorrelation, drift, or seasonality mattered.

  • Python. The stack the team uses.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 – £90,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

raw.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.

Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

Kpler is expanding its Maritime & Logistics offering through two complementary products: Container Intelligence and Automotive Intelligence. Container Intelligence builds on Kpler’s existing container tracking capabilities, providing per-container ocean visibility alongside insights into terminal congestion, queues, stay and wait times, and predictive vessel ETAs and ETDs. Automotive Intelligence represents a new product opportunity, transforming Kpler’s data into a dedicated workspace for the automotive sector.

As a Senior Product Manager, Container & Automotive Intelligence, you will own both products end to end, balancing the growth of an established offering with the development and launch of a new product from the ground up. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, Engineering, Data, Sales, Marketing and sector teams, you will define product strategy, prioritise roadmaps, lead customer discovery and drive go-to-market execution.

For Container Intelligence, your focus will be on expanding product capabilities, improving prediction quality and coverage, and increasing customer adoption and commercial growth. For Automotive Intelligence, you will work with the Automotive Sector Lead, Data Engineers and Automotive Analyst to shape the product strategy, define the initial offering and deliver a first release targeted for early 2027.

This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional who can manage multiple workstreams in parallel, make clear trade-offs and deliver data-driven products in an evolving market. You will be expected to take a pragmatic, iterative approach, launching products and capabilities efficiently before continuously improving them through customer feedback and market insights.

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Container Intelligence and Automotive Intelligence, balancing customer needs, commercial impact, development effort and data readiness across both products.

  • Drive go-to-market execution for both products, working with Product Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing input and launch planning, while securing design partners and supporting early customer adoption for Automotive Intelligence.

  • Investigate production incidents, perform thorough root-cause analysis, and implement long-term structural improvements.

title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
description: The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers. Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them. Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale. Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product. As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director. What You'll Do Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use. Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints. Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers. Bring design to life in code, building and shipping high-quality front-end experiences with close attention to performance, accessibility and detail. Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap. Use prototypes, storytelling and experimentation to make complex ideas tangible, build alignment and help teams navigate trade-offs. Explore how generative AI and agentic tools can improve design and development workflows, while creating thoughtful experiences for products used by people and AI agents. Raise the bar for design craft across the team, championing design systems, inclusive experiences and a culture of collaboration, feedback and continuous learning.   Who You Are You have a strong background in product design, with experience shaping complex digital products and delivering high-quality visual and interaction design. You're comfortable working across strategy and execution, setting a clear product direction while staying close to the details of design and delivery. You can build and ship user interfaces using a modern front-end technology stack, and enjoy bringing your designs into production. You understand how to create cohesive visual experiences across product and brand, with a thoughtful approach to interaction, motion and design systems. You bring an understanding of developer tools, enterprise software or platform products, including the challenges of designing for technical audiences. You use generative AI and agentic tools in your work, applying sound judgement about where they add value and where human expertise matters most. You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, using research, data and customer insights to make informed decisions and solve complex problems. You communicate ideas clearly, build trust across disciplines and influence product decisions through compelling design work and storytelling. You care about helping others grow, welcome different perspectives and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative environment where great work can happen. Where You'll Be This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! description: We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to make Spotify easier to enjoy across the devices people use every day. You will work in Seamless within Platform & Partner Experience, focusing on Spotify Connect and the experiences that help people find, choose, and control where Spotify plays. You will bring together user understanding, product judgment, and technical curiosity to make complex interactions feel effortless. From discovering the right device to keeping an experience consistent as people move through their day, you will help build products people can trust. What You'll Do Own the product strategy and roadmap for your scope within Spotify Connect, turning the broader Seamless direction into clear priorities. Work with research and data colleagues to understand cross-device behavior, identify friction, and define measures of success. Partner with engineering and design to deliver intuitive and reliable experiences for discovering devices, controlling playback, and moving between them. Balance improvements to everyday usability and reliability with experiments that uncover new value. Work across teams and partner-facing functions to manage dependencies and deliver a coherent end-to-end experience. Explore opportunities created by richer device understanding and emerging ways of interacting with Spotify, keeping privacy, permissions, and user control central. Clearly communicate product choices, progress, and results, and use what you learn to improve the roadmap. Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. You'll manage a high volume of opportunities, work with one or a small group of decision-makers (often a hands-on engineering leader or CTO), and move deals efficiently from the first conversation to close. You'll also help shape the playbook that enables our commercial business to grow.

You'll collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to create a seamless customer experience. Your ability to quickly understand customers' technical needs and connect them to clear business value will be key to your success.


What You'll Do

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with companies of fewer than 1,000 employees. While significant inbound demand supports the pipeline, top performers will exceed targets by treating this as a “Hunter” role in addition to converting inbound demand.

• Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demos, proposals, negotiations, and close.

• Manage a high-velocity pipeline across multiple opportunities, keeping deals moving with clear next steps and maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data in the CRM.

• Achieve and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

• Run efficient, repeatable sales processes and contribute to playbooks that help scale our commercial sales motion.

• Partner with Marketing on inbound and outbound pipeline generation, responding quickly to leads and identifying new opportunities.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Present case studies and customer success stories that demonstrate the impact and business value of our products.

• Partner with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and ensure a smooth handoff to Customer Success to support onboarding, retention, and expansion.

• Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.


Who You Are

• You have 4+ years of experience in a quota-carrying sales role, including 2+ years in a revenue-closing role, ideally in SaaS, developer platforms, or cloud services.

• You have a proven track record of achieving and exceeding targets in a fast-paced, high-volume B2B environment, ideally selling to small and medium-sized businesses (SMB) or mid-market companies.

• You are skilled at managing fast sales cycles efficiently while maintaining a thoughtful and effective discovery process.

• You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information, allowing you to prioritize high-potential opportunities and confidently move away from poorly qualified deals.

• You have experience selling to technical stakeholders, including CTOs, engineering leaders, developers, or DevOps teams.

• You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems.

• You can clearly communicate technical benefits and business value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• You bring strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills.

• You are highly organized and disciplined in pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM hygiene.

• You are excited to help build a scalable sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.


Where You'll Be

This role is based in London.

Hi, we’re Bloom & Wild. We don’t just send flowers. We help our customers to care wildly. Caring wildly is celebrating the little things we all do for each other every day. Not just the big occasions. It’s being there for the highs. Stepping up for the lows.
 
We care wildly about people and our planet. Which is why we’re so proud to be a certified B Corp™ – committed to making long-term positive change for our community, and the world around us.
 
Founded in 2013, our mission back then was to make sending and receiving flowers the joy that it should be, by harnessing technology, brand and letterbox delivery. We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.
 
Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 
 
 
🛠️ The Digital Marketing Team @ Bloom & Wild Group

The digital marketing team is responsible for driving sustainable growth in all of the markets we operate in through the execution of innovative, creative and measurable campaigns.

You’ll work on paid search campaigns targeting both new and existing customers, working across both our acquisition and retention teams to drive growth across multiple markets, brands and categories.

The wider team works collaboratively with internal stakeholders including brand, international, data, and product, while directly managing our external search agency to surface crucial insights and maximize campaign performance.


⚙️ What you'll be doing:

  • Own paid search strategy: lead paid search strategy, developing and executing campaigns across UK, DE, NL and other markets, ensuring alignment with wider marketing, brand and business goals – in particular, supporting Bloom & Wild Group's positioning as a gifting brand, not just selling flowers but also hampers, home, food & drink and more.

  • Own the budget: manage our search budget end-to-end, tracking CAC, LTV and retention costs (RC) to guide investment decisions.

  • Lead our agency partner: Oversee and manage third-party agency partner to execute high-performing campaigns and maximize ROI. Hold the agency accountable to performance targets, strict SLAs, and industry best practices, ensuring they continuously push the boundaries of modern search strategy by adopting cutting-edge tactics, beta programs, and new platform features.

  • Set the optimisation approach: set the keyword strategy, ad copy testing and audience-targeting approach that agency partners and stakeholders execute against, driving Quality Score, CTR and conversion efficiency.

  • Own App Campaigns: oversee Google App Campaigns and Apple Search Ads to drive installs and engagement, aligned to our retention and LTV goals.

  • Manage the Google relationship: work with our Google account manager to unlock alpha/beta opportunities, escalate issues and secure strategic support, along with our agency.

  • Own feed & process: own and continuously improve product feeds and backend processes for Google Shopping and Performance Max (PMax) campaigns.

  • Shape the roadmap: turn channel performance and data into clear, actionable insights that shape the wider paid media roadmap and forecasting, using Tableau and in-platform reporting.

  • Stay ahead of the platform: stay up to date with best practices and market insights, particularly with Google, to prepare for upcoming changes, test new features and champion the latest innovations.

  • Champion AI in search: maintain deep, practical knowledge of modern AI within search engine marketing – platform-level generative AI features, algorithmic updates and LLM-driven search behaviours – and share what you learn with the wider marketing team.

  • Be the go-to expert: act as the go-to person for paid search across the marketing team – mentoring junior colleagues, sharing learnings (e.g. through Lunch & Learns) and giving constructive feedback on paid search work outside your direct remit.

  • Protect share of voice: proactively monitor the competitor landscape, ensuring market share of voice, especially through peak trading moments.


    • ✅ You’ll love this role if you…

  • Are an expert in Google Paid Search: You have extensive, hands-on experience managing Google Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns at scale (experience with Microsoft Advertising or App Campaigns is a bonus).

  • Are fluent in tracking and analytics: You are comfortable working with analytics tools, conversion tracking, and Google Merchant Center, and feel confident navigating privacy- and consent-driven changes to measurement.

  • Love data and reporting: You are a data-driven decision-maker who thrives on deriving insights. You are comfortable using both in-platform tools and Tableau to analyze performance across our custom-built, proprietary e-commerce stack (non-Shopify).

  • Have agency management experience: You have a proven track record of managing third-party agencies to drive results and maintain strategic alignment.

  • Are proactive and hands-on: You take full responsibility and initiative to get things done, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in.

  • Are structured and organized: You take a thoughtful approach to planning, organization, and prioritizing your work to deliver on key business goals.

  • Are curious and adaptable: You love figuring out new tech, testing, learning, and trying new things, often taking the initiative to optimize and improve existing processes.

    •  
    These are some of the skills and experience we think will enable success in this role, but please don’t worry if you are missing some of these. We’re committed to building a team made up of different strengths, skills and experiences, so if you’re excited about our values, passionate about what you do and would like to join us in doing things more thoughtfully, we’d love to hear from you.
    🏡 Belonging @ Bloom & Wild
    We know that we learn through our differences, and building a diverse team has always been central to creating the best experience for our customers.  We value all backgrounds, perspectives, ideas and experiences, and encourage everyone to share their opinions openly within our caring and inclusive team.  Our champions community actively advances our culture of inclusion and belonging, which is organised around 8 pillars of diversity. These cross-business networks offer additional opportunities for connection, education, support and celebration, and ensure that inclusivity continues to be embedded in our ways of working.  
     
    🧭 Our ways of working
    We really believe in the power of connection. For us that looks different depending on the team you work in. Some of our teams work together in person every day, whereas others may connect in person every quarter. 
    We also believe in flexibility that supports you, the work you do, and your team.  How much you work from home and from our office depends on a balance of those needs, and you’ll agree this with your manager.
    Whether it’s through a shared project, a learning and development opportunity, or an afterwork social - we trust our teams to make the right decisions (for them and us) about where and how they work each day.
     
    We’re big on collaboration, empathy, knowledge sharing and growth, and our values drive our priorities every day:
     
    Lead change for good: we have the guts to try new things and step up to do what matters most
    Think deeply, act swiftly: we make sure there’s thoughtful rationale behind our approach and always act swiftly to implement ideas 
    Care wildly: we pour care and creativity into everything we do and pay attention to the things that make a difference
    Stay open, be curious: we’re open about what we’re doing and why, and we welcome challenges from each other
     
    🌟 Work that works for you
    To care wildly for our customers, firstly we care wildly for our teams. We work hard to craft a culture of thoughtfulness and care, where there is a strong sense of inclusion and belonging, enabling all of our people to thrive and be successful each day. 
     
    Our perks and benefits include:
    ⏰ Flexible working & work from abroad 
    🌴 25 days holiday + your birthday + flexible bank holidays, & option to buy additional holiday each year
    💛 1 Volunteering day each year
    🐣 Enhanced family leave and a workplace nursery scheme
    🌱 A flexible training framework for every stage of your career 
    💐 Irresistible discounts on our products, blooms & subscriptions!
    📈 Share in our success with a choice to take equity options from day 1
    🏋 ClassPass membership: monthly credits to spend on fitness classes, yoga and much more! 
     
    For more information on our perks & bens, please see www.bloomandwild.com/careers
     
    🫱‍🫲 Getting hired
    We know that job searching can be daunting, and we want to do everything we can to ensure that your experience with us is a good one. Interviewing is a 2-way process, and we’re keen to answer all of the questions you have, so that you can be sure (and excited!) that we’re the right move for you. 
     
    We believe in leading change for good, so if there’s anything that we can do to help you flourish throughout your application process with us, or if you have any feedback, please share this with us anonymously here so we can use this to improve your experience. 
     
    #Bloom&Wild

  • Deliver trustworthy data. Support the teams to establish modelling conventions (e.g., layer boundaries, naming, contracts), data quality SLAs, and a governed metrics layer consumable by our ThoughtSpot visualisation platform.  
  • Security, privacy & compliance. Champion least‑privilege access, encryption, auditability and privacy‑by‑design across all datasets.
  • People & performance. Lead managers and senior ICs; grow capability through coaching, clear career paths, hiring, and a high‑performance, inclusive culture.

title: Senior AI Support Engineer (Paris)
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . The role Support at Dust is not a cost center. It is one of the most important product surfaces we own. As a Senior AI Support Engineer , you will help define what world-class support looks like in an AI-native company. You will not just resolve tickets. You will own the systems, agents, workflows, and feedback loops that make support better, faster, and more scalable over time. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has already operated close to support strategy, technical escalation, user experience, and automation. You should be excited by the idea of taking recurring customer pain and turning it into durable systems: better agents, better documentation, better internal tooling, sharper product feedback, and fewer repeat issues. The best person for this role is not a traditional support leader who wants to manage a queue from a distance. It is someone with strong technical instincts, a deep user mindset, and a track record of building support systems that change how a team operates. You might be a great fit if you have built an AI-powered support function, owned support tooling at scale, worked deeply with LLMs or automation, or carried a support strategy from problem discovery through implementation and measurement. What you will own Building the AI systems that make support scale You will design, build, and continuously improve the AI-powered systems that help Dust support customers with speed and quality. This includes agents for ticket classification, auto-acknowledgement, response drafting, internal routing, proactive incident detection, knowledge retrieval, and escalation support. You will identify categories of recurring issues and engineer them out of the support queue. Sometimes that means building a better Dust agent. Sometimes it means improving documentation, creating an internal tool, tightening a workflow, writing a script, or escalating product feedback upstream with enough context for engineering to act. You will be expected to measure whether the systems you build actually improve the user experience. Seniority here means not just shipping tooling, but knowing what good looks like, instrumenting it, and iterating until the impact is visible. Running complex support when the systems fall short You will still be close to the work. You will investigate complex customer issues across logs, code, internal tooling, product behavior, and agent outputs. You will provide clear, accurate answers to customers, including when the underlying issue is ambiguous or technically complex. You will handle escalated cases with precision and judgment, communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical users. You should be comfortable translating between customer language, product behavior, engineering detail, and business impact. When AI-generated responses are incomplete, inconsistent, or wrong, you will debug the system behind them. You will improve prompts, knowledge sources, workflows, routing, tooling, and escalation paths so that the same failure mode does not repeat. Shaping the support strategy You will help define how Dust should run support as we scale. That means thinking beyond the queue and owning the full loop: what customers experience, what support sees, what agents can handle, what engineering needs to fix, and what product should learn. You will translate repeated customer pain into high-quality product signal. You will build strong working relationships with engineers and product teams so escalations are high-context, actionable, and efficient. You will also help raise the bar for how the support function operates: what we measure, how we prioritize, how we review quality, how we onboard junior team members, and how we decide what should be automated versus handled by a human. What we are looking for Every candidate and employee’s success at Dust is measured against the same three dimensions: Aptitude, Attitude, and Agency . Aptitude You have strong technical depth. You are comfortable with APIs, web applications, logs, scripts, and internal tools. You can navigate a codebase, reason through product behavior, and troubleshoot systems without being stopped by a stack trace. You have genuine AI fluency at builder level. You have built agents, automations, workflows, or internal tools using AI systems such as Dust, Cursor, Claude Code, n8n, GPT-4, Claude, Mistral, Gemini, or similar platforms. You are not just good at prompting. You understand how to turn AI into operational leverage. You have experience operating at the strategy layer of support, not only at the ticket layer. You have owned or helped shape support systems, support tooling, escalation workflows, deflection strategy, knowledge management, or AI support operations. You can balance technical accuracy with user experience. You care about whether the customer understood the answer, whether the product pain was addressed, and whether the issue will happen again. You are able to communicate bidirectionally: clearly enough for customers, technically enough for engineers, and strategically enough for leadership. Attitude You combine resilience with empathy. This is a front-line role, and customer frustration is often direct and unfiltered. You do not take it personally, but you do take it seriously. You are proactive rather than reactive. You do not wait for a perfect problem statement from the customer. You investigate, infer, clarify, and anticipate what they may need next. You have strong prioritization judgment. You know what needs an immediate human response, what can be automated, what should be escalated, and what should become product feedback. You are comfortable setting boundaries. You do not say yes to everything, and you can explain tradeoffs clearly in a way that builds trust rather than eroding it. You care about the craft of support. You see support as a product experience, not a back-office function. Agency You turn patterns into systems. When you see the same issue twice, you start asking whether it should exist at all. You go deep before escalating. You investigate as far as you reasonably can, so that when you involve engineering or product, they receive a clear problem statement, relevant evidence, and a useful recommendation. You build without waiting for permission. If you see a gap in the support system, you are excited to prototype, test, and ship a better version. You continuously improve your own workflows. You treat your time, your tools, and your operating system as things worth debugging. You extract product opportunities from customer interactions. You do not let support signal disappear into a solved ticket. You close the loop. What strong candidates may have done before You may have: Built or led an AI-powered support function Designed support agents, internal copilots, escalation workflows, or deflection systems Owned technical support tooling, support operations, or automation at a fast-growing software company Worked as a senior support engineer, technical support engineer, developer support engineer, support ops engineer, solutions engineer, or implementation engineer Built a support product, internal platform, AI startup, or automation-heavy support system Operated in a high-volume environment where quality, speed, and judgment all mattered We care more about the depth and relevance of your experience than the exact number of years. That said, we expect this role to be a fit for someone who has already spent several years close to technical support, support engineering, AI tooling, or support systems ownership. What this role is not This is not a traditional customer support role focused only on ticket resolution. It is not a people-management role where you are far away from the technical work. It is not a pure operations role where you optimize process without building. It is not a role for someone who is curious about AI but has not yet built with it. The person we are looking for should be excited to own the messy middle between customers, AI agents, internal tooling, engineering, and product. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.

Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE
 
 
Rattaché(e) au Directeur Image, Le/la Head of Production Photos E-Commerce est responsable du pilotage global des productions photographiques  destinées à l’e-commerce et au showroom.

Il/elle supervise l’ensemble de la chaîne de production, de la planification des shootings à la livraison des images finales, en 
passant par la sélection des équipes créatives et techniques, la gestion des budgets et des plannings, ainsi que le suivi de la post production, de la retouche et du contrôle qualité.

Garant(e) du rendu visuel et de la conformité des images produites, il/elle assure la fluidité des flux d’images, l’optimisation des budgets et la coordination des équipes internes et des prestataires externes.

Le poste combine une forte dimension opérationnelle et managériale, un rôle de pilotage budgétaire et une responsabilité creative dans la réalisation des supports visuels.
 
 
 
 
 
 
VOS MISSIONS 
 
 

Pilotage de la production photographique e-commerce

  • Piloter l’ensemble des productions photographiques destinées au site e-commerce : packshots, visuels portés. 
  • Planifier et prioriser les shootings en fonction du calendrier des drops et des mises en ligne e-commerce, des besoins de publication et des échéances de livraison
  • Identifier les produits restant à shooter, les produits jamais photographiés et les produits présentant des non-conformités nécessitant une nouvelle prise de vue
  • Arbitrer les priorités de production en fonction des impératifs de mise en ligne, des volumes à traiter, des ressources disponibles et des budgets alloués
  • Organiser et superviser les shootings, de la préparation à la livraison finale des assets.
  • Assurer l’art buying : identification, sélection et coordination des équipes créatives et techniques (photographes, mannequins, stylistes et autres intervenants)
  • Création de moodboard 
  • Editer les images on set en cohérence avec la direction artistique et la mise en avnat du produit
  • Piloter les budgets, les plannings et les ressources nécessaires à la réalisation des productions
  • Superviser les étapes de post-production et de retouche, en garantissant le respect des standards de qualité attendus
  • Être garant(e) du rendu visuel, de la cohérence et de la qualité des images diffusées sur le site

 

Direction artistique, sélection et édition des images

  • Assurer une sélection et une édition des images dès la phase de shooting, en fonction de la direction artistique définie, desbesoins de communication et de la mise en valeur des produits
  • Faire preuve d’un œil créatif affirmé afin d’identifier les images les plus pertinentes, tant sur le plan esthétique que dans leur capacité à valoriser le produit, sa coupe, sa matière et ses détails
  • Arbitrer les choix de prises de vue et sélectionner les visuels les plus adaptés aux usages e-commerce et showroom, en 
    garantissant la cohérence du rendu visuel et le respect de l’identité de la marque
  • Collaborer avec les équipes créatives et les photographes pendant les shootings afin d’ajuster les prises de vue et les sélections en fonction des résultats obtenus et des objectifs visuels
  • Concevoir des moodboards de direction artistique en amont des productions afin de définir les intentions visuelles, les références, les cadrages et les orientations créatives des shootings

 

Pilotage de la production showroom et des lookbooks

  • Piloter l’organisation et la production des shootings destinés au showroom
  • Superviser la réalisation des lookbooks, de la préparation des prises de vue à la livraison des visuels finaux
  • Assurer le lien entre les besoins créatifs, les contraintes de production et les objectifs de livraison

 

Supervision de la post-production, de la retouche et des flux d’images

  • Superviser l’ensemble des processus de post-production, de la réception des prises de vue à la livraison des fichiers finaux
  • Piloter la retouche réalisée en interne et auprès de prestataires externes
  • Contrôler la conformité des visuels aux gabarits attendus, notamment en matière de cadrage, de format, de dimensions et de respect des standards de livraison
  • Vérifier les chromies et la fidélité colorimétrique des images afin de garantir la cohérence du rendu visuel et la fidélité réel des produits
  • Identifier et suivre les non-conformités produits détectées lors des shootings ou de la post-production, en coordonnant les actions correctives nécessaires
  • Déterminer les besoins de nouvelles prises de vue lorsque les images existantes sont absentes, incomplètes ou non conformes aux exigences de qualité
  • Anticiper les points de blocage et mettre en place les ajustements nécessaires pour garantir la fluidité des opérations.
  • Veiller à l’efficacité des méthodes de travail et à l’amélioration continue des processus de production et de post-production

 

Management et coordination des équipes

  • Manager et coordonner une équipe de 3 à 5 personnes au total quotidiennement et toutes les équipes externes pendant les shootings
  • Encadrer directement les fonctions liés à la production et à la coordination des visuels.-Superviser l’activité quotidienne, définir les priorités et assurer la bonne répartition des missions
  • Collaborer étroitement avec la productrice afin de piloter les productions et d’assurer leur bon déroulement
  • Coordonner les équipes internes et les prestataires externes impliqués dans les shootings, la retouche et la livraison des images

 

Gestion budgétaire et pilotage des prestataires

  • Assurer le suivi des dépenses et veiller à la maîtrise des coûts

  • Arbitrer les priorités de production en tenant compte des contraintes budgétaires, des plannings, des volumes à traiter et des impératifs de mise en ligne
 
 
 
 
VOTRE PROFIL
 
 
Expertise métier

  • Maîtrise de l’organisation et du pilotage de shootings photo à forts volumes

Faisant preuve d’un professionnalisme irréprochable envers nos managers, nos collaborateurs et nos clients, vous êtes chargé(e) de la gestion quotidienne du Club, de l’organisation des événements qui y sont associés, ainsi que de l’expérience des membres et de leurs invités. Vous veiller au quotidien à ce que l’ensemble de l’équipe du Club fasse preuve d’une attitude positive, en accord avec les valeurs de Soho House Paris.</p> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Missions principales et responsabilités</strong></p> <ul> <li>Superviser les activités afférentes à la Restauration précisément du Club, du Bar et du Cabaret</li> <li>Recruter, encadrer, développer et former le personnel de la Restauration</li> <li>Être un leader inspirant pour l’équipe, la House et savoir résoudre les éventuelles difficultés rencontrées</li> <li>Connaître le budget alloué au département et plus généralement à la House, gérer le revenu des espaces de ventes restauration du Soho House Paris</li> <li>Optimiser les revenus du département restauration et faire des propositions pour augmenter les revenus des points de vente en fonction des évènements de la House, des évènements sur Paris et des saisons</li> <li>S’assurer de la bonne continuité des opérations des espaces de restauration (revenus, personnel, membres, etc.) et favoriser un climat de coopération et de respect dans ces espaces</li> <li>Être en charge de la coordination entre tous les départements et plus particulièrement entre le Club, le Bar et les Evènements</li> <li>Superviser et faire le suivi des approvisionnements, des commandes, des stocks et des inventaires en vue de respecter le budget alloué et les «&nbsp;costs&nbsp;»</li> <li>Être en mesure d’expliquer les ventes, les chiffres d’affaires et les écarts stocks-inventaires pour les rapports financiers hebdomadaires et mensuels</li> <li>Veiller à atteindre les objectifs financiers alloués aux espaces restauration, à les dépasser et être capable d’apporter des solutions en cas de retards financiers</li> <li>Connaître les différents coûts et dépenses des espaces de restauration pour faire le suivi avec le département Financier et la Direction</li> <li>Elaborer conjointement avec la Direction du Soho House Paris et la Direction Financière le budget du département restauration</li> <li>Calculer et connaître les besoins en cours et futurs en termes d’équipements, ustensiles et linges, superviser les commandes</li> <li>Être en charge des projets des espaces restauration, du suivi et de l’avancé des projets (concepts éphémères, soirées exceptionnelles, animations saisonnières, etc.)</li> <li>Superviser la relation des équipes de la restauration avec les membres en veillant à ce que les commentaires, les avis et feedbacks soient pris en compte en vue d’assurer une offre de service satisfaisante pour la clientèle</li> <li>Faire part à sa hiérarchie des retours de la clientèle et des équipes, proposer des améliorations, des solutions en fonction des points mentionnés</li> <li>Connaître et appliquer <li>Maîtriser les standards et techniques de services tout en ayant une connaissance accrue des produits, des recettes</li> <li>Connaître les fournisseurs, leurs tarifs et leurs offres, rechercher de nouveaux fournisseurs pour négocier les tarifs</li> <li>Mettre en place et conduire les formations pour les équipes supervisées et les équipes de la House en coordonnant la mise en place des formations mensuelles «&nbsp;<em>Cook House</em>» et «&nbsp;<em>House Tonic</em>&nbsp;» ainsi que les formations techniques de service et autres formations dispensées par Soho House et Soho House Paris</li> <li>Assister à toutes les dégustations des menus élaborés par le Chef Exécutif, collaborer avec le Chef Exécutif sur les menus en proposants des conseils avisés et faire un retour constructif à la Direction quant aux dégustations, saisonnalités des produits, qualités des produits et retours éventuels des membres</li> <li>S’assurer et effectuer les contrôles et les inspections des installations et équipements techniques des espaces restauration, de sécurité et coordonner avec le département de la Maintenance pour maintenir les équipements et matériels en bon état House</li> <li>Se tenir informé(e) des rapports «&nbsp;Mystery Guest&nbsp;» et audits internes pour agir sur les axes d’amélioration et faire un retour aux équipes</li> <li>Veillez à ce que les règles raw.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We want you as a highly talented Valve Test Engineer II, to help us advance our mission by leading cryogenic valve testing for our high-thrust engine. You will be the primary engineer responsible for defining, planning, executing, and closing valve development test campaigns.


Key responsibilities:

In your capacity as a cryogenic Valve Test Engineer II, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Own the valve component-level development test execution for Storm

  • Translate engineering questions and requirements into test plans, matrices, procedures, and success criteria

  • Define test sequencing, configurations, instrumentation, data needs, and readiness criteria

  • Coordinate hardware, test bench, facility, calibration, safety, and operational preparation

  • Lead safety analysis and test readiness reviews and drive campaign execution through completion

  • Execute and oversee functional, pressure, flow, transient, environmental, endurance, and other campaign-specific tests

  • Analyse test data, assess anomalies, and distinguish hardware behaviour from test-system effects

  • Produce clear test reports with conclusions, limitations, recommendations, and requirement traceability

  • Drive root-cause investigations and use test evidence to guide design iterations and follow-on testing

  • Act as the valve-test focal point across design, analysis, manufacturing, quality, systems, and integration teams


Qualifications:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, propulsion, or a closely related discipline

  • 3-4 years of experience planning and executing hardware development or qualification tests, ideally involving valves, fluid components, propulsion hardware, or other pressure-bearing components


What we would love to see from you:

  • Strong hands-on experience with functional, pressure, flow, transient, leak, environmental, endurance, or burst testing of cryogenic components

  • Practical knowledge of test planning, instrumentation, data acquisition, test execution, and engineering data analysis

  • Ability to turn requirements and engineering questions into measurable test objectives, procedures, and acceptance criteria

  • Able to work hands-on with hardware and test benches, data acquisition systems, investigate anomalies, and make evidence-based decisions

  • Strong technical writing, communication, safety, risk-management, and configuration-control skills

  • Comfortable owning a technical topic independently while coordinating effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams

  • Experience in space hardware, propulsion, safety-critical, or regulated environments is an advantage

  • Rigor and attention to detail are core values in everything we do: you take the time to understand requirements, follow procedures precisely, check your work, and maintain accurate records.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, taking ownership of getting the hardware ready

  • Fluency in English, both written and verbal

  • A passion for space exploration and the motivation to see propulsion hardware move from drawings to tested engines.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. The Role As a Legal Operations Specialist – Data Licensing on the IP & Licensing team, you will own the processes that let Mistral license content and data without slowing down. This role exists because we need someone who can turn legal analysis into repeatable workflows — managing rights, obligations, and restrictions across our growing dataset portfolio. You will work closely with the colleagues who negotiate our commercial and legal agreements, turning their work into clear metadata, tracked obligations, and automated systems. Your impact will be visible in how smoothly data moves into our AI products: fewer bottlenecks, clearer rights status, and one reliable record for every data agreement we sign. You will sit where copyright, data protection, and AI meet, making sure that as we acquire and use training data, we comply with EU and US law, respect third-party rights, and enforce the restrictions our contracts impose. In scope: clearing permissions for inbound data, reviewing and codifying contracts, maintaining a central rights-and-obligations database, and building AI-powered workflows that make all of this scalable. Review data-related agreements and codify their key terms into structured metadata, maintaining our template library and playbook alongside Legal. Assess whether specific AI use cases fall within the scope of third-party agreements, flag gaps, and recommend contract amendments. Build and maintain a central database that serves as the single source of truth for every signed data-related agreement. Track and manage compliance with ongoing obligations — permitted uses, confidentiality, re-use rights — automate our reporting, and administer master licensing partnerships. Verify provenance, ownership, and consent for acquired data, and identify obligations that require active monitoring. Monitor that Mistral clients and partners stay within their granted rights, operating the approval system that enforces legal restrictions. Design and run AI-powered workflows for contract review assistance, obligation extraction, and renewal alerts. What We're Looking For A bachelor's degree in law, publishing, information science, business, or a related field. 2–5 years of experience in copyright, permissions, licensing, legal operations, or contract administration — ideally in an AI, tech, or data-driven environment. Working knowledge of EU and US copyright law and contract administration, with demonstrated ability to interpret contracts independently. Meticulous attention to detail and discretion with confidential contracts, combined with strong project-management skills. Clear, direct communication and the initiative to anticipate needs through ambiguity. A legal-ops mindset: you want to turn legal analysis into repeatable, scalable processes, not just handle one-off reviews. Comfort building agentic AI workflows in a complex enterprise environment — you are an AI power user, ideally with experience setting up such workflows in a legal team.
