Base360.ai is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Product Engineer who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build solutions for:

  • Real-time reservation and availability synchronization

  • Dynamic pricing intelligence

  • Smart lock access and key management

  • Automated guest communication across channels

  • Guest check-in and upsell journeys

  • Operational forecasting

  • Cleaning and maintenance automation

  • Owner reporting and financial workflows

  • AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

  • Python

  • FastAPI

  • React

  • TypeScript

  • Supabase

  • PostgreSQL

  • AWS

  • Serverless architecture

  • OpenAI APIs

  • Twilio

  • Stripe

  • Docker

  • GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

  • Strong experience building and shipping production software

  • The ability to work across frontend and backend systems

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies

  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture

  • A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature

  • Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs

  • The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution

  • Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders

  • The ability to work independently and own outcomes

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency

  • A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus points for experience with:

  • Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems

  • Multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations

  • AI agents and workflow automation

  • Product analytics and experimentation

  • Event-driven architectures

  • Supabase

  • AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 12 months:

  • You've shipped features that property managers actively use

  • Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built

  • Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks

  • Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete

  • Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably

  • AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations

  • Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions

  • Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

description: ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE : École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation. Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être. IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient. IMT Mines Albi, au travers du Centre Génie Industriel (CGI), développe des recherches à la frontière entre l’intelligence artificielle et le génie industriel, en collaboration avec des partenaires publics et industriels nationaux et internationaux. Le Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) ( https://cgi.imt-mines-albi.fr/ ) compte environ 70 personnes dont 25 doctorants. Le centre s’intéresse à l’accompagnement de la transition des écosystèmes en permettant de prendre des décisions responsables et durables, dans des environnements instables ou perturbés. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés. Le CGI est structuré selon des axes de recherche appliquée et des programmes scientifiques. Les axes de recherche appliquée sont : Axe FLOWS : Flexible Logistics and Operations for sustainable WorldS   dans lequel ce poste est rattaché . Axe DiSCS : Digital Systems for Crisis management and Security ; Axe TRACE : Territorial Resilience, Agility, and Circular Economy ; Axe WHOPS : Well-being and Health through Organizational Processes and Services . Les deux programmes scientifiques au cœur de ces axes de recherche sont : HOPOPOP : Hybridization for Operations & Planning, Organizations & Performance, Optimization & Problem-solving ;  AIME-DM : Automated Information Modeling and Extraction for Decision-Makers .   DESCRIPTION DU POSTE : Dans le contexte de l’Education 4.0, les différents acteurs d’un établissement de formation universitaire (étudiants, personnels, intervenants extérieurs, etc.) ont des contraintes et des objectifs différents ce qui rend complexe la coordination et le pilotage de tels établissements (organisation et planification des enseignements, gestion des espaces collectifs, organisation des sessions d’examens…). En complément, ces établissements doivent s’adapter tant sur la gestion de leurs sites (meilleure adéquation à de nouvelles formes pédagogiques) que sur les flux de personnes les utilisant pour une meilleure répartition des charges et une interopérabilité de tous les outils à disposition (par exemple, un gestionnaire d’emploi du temps). Dans ce cadre, le jumeau numérique organisationnel représente le système qui permet une simulation et une aide à la prise de décision par des échanges bidirectionnels entre l’organisation physique (personnes et systèmes dont les bâtiments) et sa réplique virtuelle dans un objectif de pilotage global des flux. Le projet DIGIFAC’Santé s’inscrit dans ce contexte. Il porte sur la conception et le développement d'un jumeau numérique des sites d’une université, de la gestion des flux étudiants et personnels et de l’évolution pédagogique de ses formations. Un jumeau numérique ne peut remplir son rôle qu'à la condition de représenter fidèlement les informations essentielles à la prise de décision, elles-mêmes issues de données collectées dans les différents services de l’Université et des applications logicielles actuelles. ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE :

École du ministère en charge de l'industrie, IMT Mines Albi est une école de l’Institut Mines- Télécom, 1er groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management de France. À l'avant-garde des enjeux industriels et académiques sur la scène internationale, elle agit comme un moteur scientifique et économique territorial en combinant ses 4 missions - former des ingénieurs en intégrant la dynamique du développement durable, faire de la recherche scientifique, contribuer au développement économique et diffuser la culture des sciences, des techniques et de l'innovation - en un cercle vertueux et porteur d'innovation.

Son positionnement en matière de formation et de recherche la place IMT Mines Albi comme école de référence sur trois des quatre thématiques de l’IMT, à savoir l’industrie du futur responsable, l’énergie, économie circulaire et société ainsi que l’ingénierie, santé et bien-être.

IMT Mines Albi s‘est dotée en 2023 et pour une période quinquennale, d’un plan stratégique décliné en 7 grandes actions, répondant ainsi aux orientations stratégiques du groupe IMT à laquelle elle appartient.

IMT Mines Albi, au travers du Centre Génie Industriel (CGI), développe des recherches à la frontière entre l’intelligence artificielle et le génie industriel, en collaboration avec des partenaires publics et industriels nationaux et internationaux.

Le Centre Génie Industriel (CGI) (https://cgi.imt-mines-albi.fr/) compte environ 70 personnes dont 25 doctorants. Le centre s’intéresse à l’accompagnement de la transition des écosystèmes en permettant de prendre des décisions responsables et durables, dans des environnements instables ou perturbés. Ceci est mis en pratique par la représentation, la modélisation et l’analyse des données de ces organisations afin de formaliser de la connaissance conduisant à la prise de décision dans des contextes hétérogènes, collaboratifs, incertains et/ou perturbés.

Le CGI est structuré selon des axes de recherche appliquée et des programmes scientifiques. Les axes de recherche appliquée sont :

  • Axe FLOWS : Flexible Logistics and Operations for sustainable WorldS dans lequel ce poste est rattaché.

  • Axe DiSCS : Digital Systems for Crisis management and Security ;

  • Axe WHOPS : Well-being and Health through Organizational Processes and Services.

Les deux programmes scientifiques au cœur de ces axes de recherche sont :

  • HOPOPOP : Hybridization for Operations & Planning, Organizations & Performance, Optimization & Problem-solving ; 

  • AIME-DM : Automated Information Modeling and Extraction for Decision-Makers.

En complément, ces établissements doivent s’adapter tant sur la gestion de leurs sites (meilleure adéquation à de nouvelles formes pédagogiques) que sur les flux de personnes les utilisant pour une meilleure répartition des charges et une interopérabilité de tous les outils à disposition (par exemple, un gestionnaire d’emploi du temps). Un jumeau numérique ne peut remplir son rôle qu'à la condition de représenter fidèlement les informations essentielles à la prise de décision, elles-mêmes issues de données collectées dans les différents services de l’Université et des applications logicielles actuelles. Ce lot interroge la capacité du système à pallier les lacunes de la remontée de données par des mécanismes d'inférence ou de déduction, permettant de reconstituer un état vraisemblable du système à partir d'informations partielles.

Il s’agit ici d’utiliser le jumeau numérique dans toutes ses fonctionnalités afin entres autres de s’assurer que les évolutions bâtimentaires envisagées permettent d’accueillir l’ensemble des flux actuel et projeté pour cet établissement, de permettre d’optimiser les flux entre les différents sites et de valider les choix d’évolution des pratiques pédagogiques et leur adéquation vis à vis des capacités disponibles (salles et équipements spécifiques, surfaces, personnels,etc.).

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables :

  • Analyse systémique

  • Analyse de données

  • Ingénierie dirigée par les modèles

  • Aide à la décision

  • Fouille de processus (process mining),

  • Des connaissances en algorithmique, UML, Web sémantique seront très appréciées

Vous encadrez les responsables de site et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'expertise centrales, les clients et les partenaires de maintenance. Dans un contexte de croissance de l'entreprise et d'exigences opérationnelles, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'harmonisation des pratiques, la structuration du pilotage des activités et l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes. Votre objectif : construire une vision opérationnelle consolidée, maîtriser les risques et fédérer les équipes autour d'exigences communes de performance, de sécurité et de qualité de service. Vos responsabilités Piloter la stratégie et la performance des opérations multisites Élaborer une feuille de route opérationnelle à court et moyen terme, en définissant les priorités, les plans d'action et les ressources humaines et financières nécessaires. Définir et harmoniser les méthodes de pilotage des activités opérationnelles sur l'ensemble des sites. Consolider et faire évoluer les KPI et tableaux de bord portant notamment sur la disponibilité des infrastructures, la maintenance, la communication client et le respect des procédures. Analyser les résultats, identifier les écarts de performance et piloter les actions correctives. Produire un reporting structuré à destination de la direction et éclairer les décisions stratégiques. Manager les responsables de site et accompagner la transformation Encadrer et accompagner les responsables de site dans le pilotage de leurs activités et le développement de leurs compétences. Apporter une expertise opérationnelle et technique permettant de challenger les choix, les priorités et les plans d'action. Favoriser l'autonomie, la responsabilisation et la coopération des équipes. Organiser l'allocation des ressources et le suivi des plans de charge. Accompagner la réorganisation du périmètre, harmoniser les pratiques et contribuer à l'intégration de nouveaux sites. Travailler en transversalité avec le responsable du pôle Expertise et les autres fonctions de l'entreprise. Garantir la fiabilité des infrastructures et maîtriser les risques Garantir la disponibilité, la résilience et la continuité d'exploitation des infrastructures critiques. Superviser la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire, ainsi que les travaux, extensions, rétrofits et changements réalisés en environnement exploité. Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques. Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires. Piloter les incidents majeurs, les escalades, les analyses de causes et le suivi des actions correctives et préventives. Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service. Développer la relation client et le partenariat avec les mainteneurs Garantir le respect des engagements contractuels, des SLA et des standards de qualité attendus par les clients. Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients. Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires. Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations. Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires. Piloter les budgets et l'amélioration continue Élaborer et suivre les budgets OPEX et CAPEX du périmètre. Arbitrer les priorités de maintenance, de renouvellement et d'investissement en fonction des risques, des capacités et des engagements clients. Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires, environnementales, HSE, ICPE et des référentiels ISO applicables. Déployer des standards, procédures et méthodes de travail homogènes. Contribuer à l'amélioration de la performance énergétique des installations, notamment du PUE, et à la maîtrise des coûts d'exploitation. Votre profil Formation et expérience Formation supérieure, idéalement Bac +5, de type ingénieur ou master spécialisé en génie électrique, énergétique, climatique, maintenance industrielle ou management des opérations. Un Bac +3 technique pourra être étudié au regard d'une expérience particulièrement solide. Expérience significative dans l'exploitation, la maintenance ou la direction technique d'infrastructures critiques. Expérience significative en management de managers, en pilotage multisite ou dans une fonction de responsabilité opérationnelle comparable. Expérience confirmée dans un environnement critique fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7, avec de fortes exigences de disponibilité, de sécurité et de conformité. Expérience en gestion d'incidents majeurs, pilotage de budgets, gestion des risques et conduite de transformations opérationnelles. Compétences techniques Bonne maîtrise des enjeux d'exploitation des data centers et compréhension des architectures électriques, mécaniques, CVC, de protection incendie, de GTB/BMS et des systèmes de contrôle. Maîtrise du pilotage de la maintenance préventive, corrective et réglementaire. Connaissance des SLA, KPI de disponibilité, capacité, qualité de service et performance énergétique. Capacité à analyser et challenger les risques techniques, les plans de maintenance et les investissements. Maîtrise des enjeux budgétaires OPEX/CAPEX et des exigences réglementaires applicables. Qualités personnelles Leadership et capacité à manager des responsables expérimentés. Crédibilité technique et sens des responsabilités. Capacité à structurer une organisation, harmoniser les pratiques et conduire le changement. Aptitude à fédérer les équipes et à développer la coopération transverse. Capacité de décision, d'arbitrage et de priorisation. Sang-froid en situation de crise, rigueur et orientation résultats. Sens du client et capacité à construire des relations de partenariat durables. Langues : français courant et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Les enjeux de réussite Au cours des premiers mois, vous aurez notamment pour objectifs de construire une feuille de route opérationnelle claire, de consolider le pilotage par les indicateurs, de hiérarchiser les risques et de définir les moyens nécessaires à leur traitement. Vous contribuerez également à renforcer la cohésion managériale, à harmoniser les pratiques entre les sites et à accompagner l'évolution de l'organisation dans une logique durable de performance et d'amélioration continue. Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise des infrastructures critiques au service d'un environnement exigeant, avec une forte dimension managériale, stratégique et transverse ? 🥇 You're the right candidate if you have experience :

  • Working with cloud environments (we use AWS).

  • Building and evolving observability and monitoring systems (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk or similar).

  • Scaling production systems and web applications, including asynchronous job systems.

  • Operating in high-growth or product-led environments.

  • Influencing engineering teams and driving reliability practices at scale.

 
 

What do we do to make your work life easier

 

🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from anywhere in Europe, as long as your contract allows you to

💵 You’ll have a compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your english or your french

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🎉 You’ll be part of a vibrant social community : we do lots of sports together (Foot, running, climbing...), we love to hang out and have a drink together (thursday afterwork drinks on our rooftop is a usual thing. Twice-a-year we do company seminars, last time we went on a trip to Centerparcs and it was fabulous !)

 

And.. If you're based in France :

 

🏢 You’ll be able to work fully from your home or any co-working space in France, or from our wonderful office in the center of Paris

🏝You’ll get between 8 to 13 additional days off (to the 25 standard ones) to rest and do what you love each year

🍜 You’ll have lunch credits (Swile card) to buy your favorite food every day

🏥 You’ll have a great healthcare cover (Alan Blue) to take care of yourself and your family

 

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 

What does the recruitment process look like ? 

 

  • Intro call with Technical Recruiter (30 min)

  • Technical interview (1h)

  • System design interview (1h)

  • Final discussion with Engineering Manager (1h)

raw.description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO)

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands)

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue)

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

This is a hands-on role for someone who can execute fast, iterate with creative and funnel inputs, and scale what works. You’ll inherit high-performing campaigns and work directly with our CMO to double down on growth.

You’ll then also have the opportunity to test and scale new channels (TikTok, Meta, Snapchat, Native, ASA) depending on performance and market constraints.

Your Responsibilities

Campaign Ownership and Scaling

  • Take the lead on one or two paid acquisition channels (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.), with potential to expand scope based on performance

  • Contribute to building scalable acquisition funnels, from execution to iteration, with aggressive growth targets in mind

  • Run high-velocity testing loops (creatives, audiences, placements) to improve CAC and LTV

Performance Analysis and Strategy

  • Monitor performance daily using tools like Voluum, GA4, and internal dashboards

  • Drive decision-making through deep analysis of CPA, ROAS, retention, and cohort behavior

  • Build and maintain internal reporting frameworks that guide strategic shifts and tactical moves

Creative & Funnel Optimization

  • Own the creative briefing process: define hooks, formats, and angles based on performance patterns

  • Collaborate closely with the content and product teams to launch and iterate on high-converting landing pages

  • Implement systems to reduce creative fatigue and increase speed of testing

Partnership Management & Media Strategy

  • Build strong relationships with traffic sources and negotiate premium placements and custom deals

  • Explore new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools) and build internal evaluation criteria

  • Stay ahead of ecosystem changes (platform rules, algorithm shifts) and adapt strategy accordingly

Automation & Scaling Systems

  • Identify opportunities to streamline acquisition processes through automation and internal tools

  • Create SOPs, playbooks, and experiment pipelines for scaling campaigns efficiently

Challenges You’ll Tackle

  • Scale existing campaigns to 3x+ budget while maintaining CAC/ROAS goals

  • Contribute to growing the user base from 30M to 100M users in the next 12 months

  • Execute 0-to-1 testing in new channels

  • Improve conversion through landing page testing and funnel iteration

  • Own both creative input and analytical feedback loops

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

Must-Haves

  • 4–10+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Proven track record managing $300K to $1M+/month in paid media spend

  • Full ownership of campaign execution, results, and optimization

  • Experience with Meta, TikTok, Snapchat, ASA, or native platforms

  • Analytical fluency: GA4, Voluum, tracking setups, dashboards

  • Strong creative instincts: can write briefs, analyze hooks, and iterate fast

  • Experience optimizing landing pages and funnel conversion

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Past exposure to subscription models and CAC/LTV frameworks

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth)

Soft Skills

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and need people who can balance execution, planning, and strategy

⏱️ Obsessive about speed, performance and iteration

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - Comfortable advertising products based on uncensored models and content

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. And beyond. ⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership. You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team , whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works. Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact Have excellent verbal and written communication skills; Have at least an advanced level in English . Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range . Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

raw.title: Senior Revenue Ops
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job

Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

Why is this role interesting?

  • High-impact scope: You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers.

  • Real ownership: You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery.

  • Builder's playground: You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale.

  • Tangible results: Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate.

What will you do with us?

You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

 

⭐ Is it you we're looking for?

You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in RevOps / Sales Ops / Sales Effectiveness, several of them spent hands-on building the sales machine. You own initiatives end-to-end (scope, design, build, measure);

  • Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives;

  • Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on;

  • Are confident with change management, including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating;

  • Can write and own SQL queries yourself (joins, basic data modeling), not just read them.

  • Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows

  • Have configured Salesforce yourself (objects, fields, flows) and can say what you personally built vs. what an integrator or another team did.

  • Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact

  • Have excellent verbal and written communication skills;

  • Have at least an advanced level in English.

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role we are looking to hire within the C1-E level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

raw.title: Communications, Brand & Events Lead
raw.description:
About Orakl Oncology

Every cancer patient deserves a treatment that works for them. Today, too many never get one in time: fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs make it through clinical trials, and every failure costs patients precious time.

Orakl exists to change those odds.

We bridge biological and artificial intelligence by building large cohorts of virtual cancer patients, combining real patients' tumors with their medical histories and deep biological data. By integrating patient-derived tumor models, experimental biology and AI, we help pharmaceutical companies predict how cancer drugs will perform in patients, identify promising treatments and make better decisions earlier in drug development.

Founded in 2023 by Fanny Jaulin, PhD, Diane-Laure Pagès, PhD, and Gustave Ronteix, PhD, Orakl is a spin-out of Gustave Roussy, one of Europe's leading cancer centres, building on a decade of research. Backed by international investors, we are scaling our technology and partnerships with pharmaceutical companies worldwide.

Discover more at orakl-oncology.com

The role

We are looking for our first Communications, Brand & Events Lead to build Orakl's external presence from the ground up and establish the company as a leading voice in AI-driven cancer drug development. Your job is to make the world understand what we are building, why it matters and why Orakl is uniquely positioned to lead this transformation.

You will shape how Orakl is perceived by the pharmaceutical companies we partner with, the scientists we want to attract, the investors backing us and the broader industry. From defining our corporate narrative and building our reputation to securing media coverage and putting Orakl in the right rooms, you will turn our scientific and commercial progress into visibility, credibility and meaningful relationships.

You will own our communications, brand and events strategy, working directly with the founders and closely with our scientific, BD and Product Marketing teams. While Product Marketing focuses on our offerings and their commercial value, you will own Orakl's corporate voice, reputation and external presence. You will also lead internal events and support on internal brand alignment.

This is a strategic but highly hands-on role. You will set the direction, build the function and execute much of it yourself, with the autonomy to experiment, make decisions and shape how Orakl grows.

You will need to combine the speed and creativity of a startup with the standards of the pharmaceutical industry. Our communications must be distinctive and ambitious, but always grounded in scientific rigour, evidence and credibility.

What you'll do

Communications and brand: building Orakl's voice

  • Communications strategy. Define and execute Orakl's communications strategy across audiences, channels and markets, setting clear priorities that support the company's commercial, scientific, talent and fundraising ambitions.

  • Corporate positioning and narrative. Own Orakl's corporate story, key messages and tone of voice. Build a distinctive narrative around virtual patients and Orakl's role in advancing cancer drug development, ensuring consistency across the company.

  • Brand identity and presence. Own and evolve Orakl's brand identity and visual expression across the website, corporate materials, presentations and digital channels, working with designers and external partners when needed.

  • Content and editorial strategy. Build and manage an editorial calendar that turns Orakl's scientific breakthroughs, company milestones and industry perspectives into compelling content for the right audiences.

  • Founders' voice and thought leadership. Build the public profiles of Orakl's founders through LinkedIn, articles, op-eds, interviews and relevant scientific and industry channels. Identify the topics and conversations where Orakl can bring a distinctive perspective.

  • Press and media relations. Develop relationships with scientific, pharmaceutical, technology and business media. Identify newsworthy stories, pitch proactively and lead communications around funding, partnerships, scientific advances and company milestones.

  • Speaking opportunities. Build and pitch a targeted pipeline of speaking engagements, panels, podcasts and interviews that position Orakl's founders and scientific leaders as recognised voices in the industry.

  • Reputation and scientific credibility. Ensure all external communications are accurate, evidence-based and consistent with Orakl's scientific standards. Help manage sensitive announcements, complex topics and reputational issues in close collaboration with leadership and scientific teams.

Events: putting Orakl in the right room

  • Events strategy and prioritization. Build Orakl's annual events strategy and calendar, identifying the conferences, industry gatherings and scientific forums that matter most to the business (e.g. JPM, BIO, AACR, BIO-Europe). Define objectives, budgets and expected outcomes for each.

  • Conference presence and execution. Own Orakl's participation in major industry events, from sponsorships, booths and speaking opportunities to registrations, logistics, travel, vendors and on-site execution.

  • Business development activation. Work closely with BD and the founders to identify priority contacts, secure relevant meetings and build targeted engagement programmes around key events. Ensure opportunities are captured and followed up.

  • Orakl-hosted events. Create and run Orakl's own event formats, from intimate scientific dinners and executive roundtables to webinars and partner gatherings, designed to strengthen relationships and generate meaningful conversations.

  • Event content and experience. Own invitations, event branding, booth design, signage and communications before, during and after events, working with Product Marketing on offering-specific and scientific commercial content.

  • Event performance. Evaluate the impact of Orakl's events against their objectives, including strategic relationships developed, meetings secured, commercial opportunities generated and visibility achieved. Use these insights to refine future investments.

Internal communications and culture

  • Internal events. Plan and deliver company off-sites, all-hands gatherings and team celebrations that bring people together and strengthen Orakl's culture.

  • Internal brand alignment. Help teams understand and consistently communicate Orakl's mission, narrative and positioning, ensuring a coherent company voice as the organisation grows.

Building the function

  • Processes and partners. Establish the tools, workflows and external partner network needed to deliver high-quality communications and events efficiently, managing agencies, freelancers and budgets.

  • Measurement and priorities. Define how communications and events success is measured, focusing on quality of visibility, audience relevance, reputation, strategic relationships and contribution to company objectives.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Work closely with founders, BD, scientific teams and Product Marketing to identify the strongest stories, align priorities and ensure communications supports Orakl's broader ambitions.

What we're looking for

  • Experience in communications, PR, brand or a related role, ideally within life sciences, biotech, healthtech or B2B technology.

  • Strong strategic communications skills, with experience developing corporate narratives, positioning and communications plans that support business objectives.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling ability, from short-form social content and executive ghostwriting to press releases, long-form editorial, website copy and event communications.

  • Experience in media relations and thought leadership, with a track record of securing relevant earned media, interviews or speaking opportunities and building executive profiles.

  • Ability to communicate complex science, translating technical and scientific concepts into compelling, accurate stories for pharma decision-makers, investors, scientists and broader audiences.

  • Strong editorial judgment, with the ability to recognize what is genuinely newsworthy, identify compelling angles and choose the right audience, channel and moment.

  • Experience in events and conference management, from strategic planning and budgeting to hands-on execution, ideally with an understanding of how events can support commercial relationships.

  • A strong eye for brand and design, with the ability to maintain high creative standards across digital and physical touchpoints.

  • Hands-on and entrepreneurial mindset, equally comfortable setting a strategy, writing a LinkedIn post, pitching a journalist or running an event on-site.

  • Autonomy, creativity and pragmatism, with the confidence to work directly with founders, manage multiple priorities and make things happen in a fast-moving startup.

  • Fluent in English, French is a plus.

  • Work on-site with occasional remote work.

You don't need to come from a traditional life sciences communications background. We value people who combine strong storytelling instincts, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment and the ability to make complex ideas accessible without compromising their accuracy.

What Orakl offers

  • Build something from the ground up. Become Orakl's first Communications, Brand & Events Lead, with the opportunity to define the function, shape its priorities and grow a team as the company scales.

  • Shape the voice of an emerging category. Help establish Orakl as a recognised leader in virtual cancer patients and AI-driven drug development.

  • Work at the frontier of AI and cancer research. Bring breakthrough scientific advances to the audiences and organisations that can turn them into real-world impact.

  • Real ownership and direct access to leadership. Work closely with our founders and scientific experts, with significant autonomy, creative freedom and room to grow.

  • Time to recharge. 25 days of paid holiday, plus approximately 9 additional rest days (RTT) per year.

  • Hybrid working. 1–2 days per week occasional work from home.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: getting to know each other, aligning on expectations context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: detailed conversation about your experience and fit for the role, using examples of what you’ve done and how you like to work.

  3. Case study: a take-home case to prepare and then to present in-person to the team.

  4. Reference Call: with one or two former colleagues with whom you worked closely, including a direct manager.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with at least one founder on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on, resourceful Recruiting & HR Operations Manager to help us attract, hire, and support exceptional talent as we grow. This role will primarily focus on full-cycle recruiting, partnering closely with hiring managers and leadership to understand business needs, build talent pipelines, and deliver an efficient, high-quality candidate experience.

While recruiting will be the priority, this role will support onboarding, employee lifecycle administration, and day-to-day HR operations for our Swiss-based team when time allows. Reporting to the Fractional HR leader based in the US, you will help build scalable, consistent people practices while providing responsive support to employees and managers.

This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys quick execution to make an impact, owning the details, building relationships, and balancing multiple priorities in a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition

  • Manage full-cycle recruiting for positions across the organization, from intake meetings and sourcing through interviews, offers, and closing candidates.

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, develop recruiting strategies, and establish clear selection criteria.

  • Source candidates through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, and other creative channels.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and anticipated hiring needs.

  • Coordinate interview processes, ensuring timely communication, structured evaluations, and a positive candidate experience.

  • Manage offer processes, including compensation coordination, offer approvals, and preparation of employment contracts in partnership with HR and leadership.

  • Track recruiting metrics, pipeline health, time-to-fill, and other key indicators to identify opportunities to improve hiring effectiveness.

  • Maintain accurate applicant tracking system records and recruiting documentation.

  • Support the development of consistent recruiting practices across locations while accounting for local market expectations.

HR Operations

  • Coordinate preboarding and onboarding activities, including background checks, system entry, equipment, relocation coordination, and orientation.

  • Partner with hiring managers and cross-functional teams to ensure new employees have a smooth, engaging start.

  • Support new-hire check-ins and identify opportunities to improve the onboarding experience.

  • Support employee lifecycle processes, including new hires, employment changes, internal transfers, and departures.

  • Assist with HR reporting, audits, and other operational projects as needed.

  • Coordinate with external payroll providers, benefits partners, and local HR or employment advisors as needed.

  • Support compliance with applicable Swiss employment requirements and internal policies in partnership with the Fractional HR leader and relevant local experts.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with the Fractional HR leader to prioritize recruiting and people initiatives aligned with business objectives.

  • Build trusted relationships with employees, hiring managers, and cross-functional partners.

  • Handle confidential employee and candidate information with discretion and sound judgment.

  • Contribute to the development of consistent, scalable HR processes in a growing organization while recognizing the need for locally appropriate practices.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting, talent acquisition, and/or HR operations, ideally in a growing technology, energy, engineering, or other technical organization.

  • Demonstrated success managing multiple open requisitions and delivering a strong candidate experience.

  • Experience recruiting for technical, commercial, operational, or corporate roles; experience in engineering or energy-related hiring is a plus.

  • Familiarity with Swiss employment practices and HR administration, or experience supporting employees in Switzerland.

  • Fluency in English; professional proficiency in French is strongly preferred given the location in Nyon and the potential need to support local employees and external partners.

  • Experience with applicant tracking systems (Ashby preferred), HRIS platforms (HiBob), and standard productivity tools.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently.

  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and willingness to roll up your sleeves to get things done.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain confidentiality.

title: Senior Consultant Digitale Transformatie
description: Bouw mee aan succesvolle IT-projecten bij ambitieuze MKB-organisaties Digital Motions helpt MKB-bedrijven bij complexe IT-vraagstukken, softwareselecties en implementaties. Veel organisaties starten een softwareselectie terwijl processen nog niet scherp zijn, belangen uiteenlopen en verwachtingen verschillen. Daardoor worden verkeerde keuzes gemaakt, ontstaan discussies tijdens implementaties en wordt software aangepast aan processen die eigenlijk eerst verbeterd hadden moeten worden. Bij Digital Motions geloven wij dat succesvolle digitale transformaties beginnen met inzicht, structuur en draagvlak. Daarom brengen wij processen, mensen en technologie samen voordat software wordt gekozen. Voor deze vraagstukken zoeken wij een Senior Consultant Digitale Transformatie. Een sterke kandidaat luistert goed, vraagt scherp door en brengt complexe informatie terug tot overzichtelijke keuzes. We zoeken geen procesnotulist, maar een consultant die inhoud toevoegt, richting geeft en klanten helpt betere besluiten te nemen. Daarnaast beschik je over: HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau. Sterk in het ontwerpen en uitwerken van bedrijfsprocessen, procesflows en procesdocumentatie. Affiniteit met de implementatie van applicaties zoals ERP, WMS, PLM, PIM en aanverwante software in operationele processen Begrip van softwareselecties- en implementatietrajecten Sterke communicatie richting directie, management, key-users en leveranciers Een gestructureerde manier van werken, eigenaarschap en een hoge kwaliteitsstandaard Benefits Wat bieden wij? Een rol voor 32, 36 of 40 uur per week met veel verantwoordelijkheid, directe klantimpact en ruimte om mee te bouwen aan Digital Motions. Uitdagende opdrachten bij MKB-organisaties in productie, handel en installatie, waar je direct impact maakt op complexe digitale transformaties.   • 25 vakantiedagen
  • Gezellige teamuitjes, feesten en borrels

description: In onze taalschakeltrajecten (onderwijsroute) naar het mbo krijgen jong volwassen inburgeraars in anderhalf tot twee jaar tijd een goede basis om te kunnen starten op én succesvol te zijn op het mbo. Wij verzorgen dit onderwijs en begeleiding kleinschalig en dichtbij huis. Cursisten kunnen bij ons op elk moment starten met de Nederlandse taallessen, samen met inburgeraars die andere inburgeringsroutes volgen. Stilstaan is geen optie. Daarna krijgen zij gefaseerd lessen rekenen, Engels en begeleiding. Deze unieke aanpak vergt een goede en vlekkeloze coördinatie en daarvoor zoeken wij jou! Taken Als coördinator taalschakeltrajecten op de locatie Alphen aan den Rijn: Ben je de spil van de taalschakeltrajecten op locatie Ben je verantwoordelijk voor de aanmeldingen en intakes van nieuwe cursisten en een gedegen advies aan de gemeente. Zorg je voor een nauwkeurige administratie, waaronder het bijhouden van cursistdossiers. Maak je leerplannen en roosters en zorg je voor de informatievoorziening aan cursisten. Volg je het traject van de cursist en zorg je tijdig en secuur – waar nodig in overleg met docenten en studieloopbaanbegeleider – voor het leerplan voor de volgende fase. Voorzie jij de studieloopbaanbegeleider van benodigde informatie over onder andere aanwezigheid en roosters en zet rapporten klaar. Organiseer jij examenperiodes en zorg je voor een nauwkeurige en vlotte afhandeling van examens en de nodige vervolgstappen. Onderhoud je goed contact met cursisten, docenten en studieloopbaanbegeleider en signaleert als er dingen niet goed gaan. Heb je regelmatig overleg met de opleidingsmanager over de zorg en verdere ontwikkeling van processen en kwaliteit van de taalschakeltrajecten. Werk je in een dynamische omgeving waar ook andere inburgeringscursussen worden gegeven en overleg je met collega’s over roosters en andere praktische zaken op locatie. Vereisten Je hebt ervaring met of aantoonbare affiniteit met (kleinschalige) projecten op gebied van NT2, mbo of onderwijs in het algemeen Je hebt ervaring met het coördineren en organiseren van onderwijs of andere educatieve projecten. Je bent communicatief sterk, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk Je hebt oog voor detail, kan goed overzicht houden, nauwkeurig en planmatig en volgens afspraken werken Je bent handig met de computer en programma’s zoals Word en Excel. Je kan goed zelfstandig werken, maar vraagt tijdig om hulp en kan tegelijkertijd goed samenwerken met collega’s en partnerorganisaties en voor draagvlak zorgen Je bent stressbestendig, kan snel schakelen en goed overzicht houden, ook in een dynamische omgeving en bij veranderingen en deadlines. Je bent initiatiefrijk, een zelfstarter, creatief en resultaatgericht Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde opleiding op HBO niveau Beheersing van een niet-Westerse taal, zoals Arabisch, is een pré Ben je enigszins flexibel bij het inzetten van je werkuren, op basis van wat de praktijk van je vraagt. Benefits Echt Nederlands biedt een leuke werkplek, een open en ongedwongen sfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en nascholing waar nodig. De bedrijfscultuur is erop gericht om samen tot mooie resultaten te komen voor onze cursisten, medewerkers en het bedrijf Een marktconform salaris afhankelijk van ervaring en leeftijd 25 vakantiedagen bij een werkweek van 40 uur; 8% vakantietoeslag en reiskostenvergoeding vanaf 10 kilometer Een werkweek van 12 tot 16 uur Een functie waarbij je werkt op locatie Alphen aan den Rijn Een eigen laptop en waar nodig telefoon Een prettige, ambitieuze, maar informele werksfeer waarin je je snel thuis zult voelen De mogelijkheid om door te groeien om meer verantwoordelijkheid te krijgen voor en mee te denken over de (inhoudelijke) ontwikkeling van onze taalschakeltrajecten. De afgelopen tien jaar heeft Echt Nederlands zich op het gebied van NT2 inburgering meer dan bewezen met een slagingspercentage tussen de 80 en 100%, vier sterren en een tevredenheidscijfer van 8,3 en dat met meer dan 1000 cursisten! Maatschappelijke betrokkenheid, een positieve benadering en persoonlijke aandacht voor onze cursisten vinden wij belangrijk. Gecombineerd met de hoge kwaliteit van onze taalcursussen, vinden cursisten bij ons een uitstekende basis voor het nastreven van persoonlijke leerdoelen. Daarmee gaan we verder binnen de nieuwe inburgering. We blijven ons ontwikkelen, samen met onze partners, waaronder de gemeente, maatschappelijke begeleiding en werkgevers. Zo dragen we bij aan een samenleving waarin iedereen naar vermogen mee kan doen en zichzelf kan ontwikkelen. Procedure Ben je geïnteresseerd? title: Marketplace specialist die scoort, niet alleen beheert
description: Ben jij klaar om productinformatie om te zetten in verkoopsucces en daarmee de marketplaces te veroveren? World of Alps – REHALL outerwear en Kampeerwinkel Roermond ontwikkelen en verkopen, hoogwaardige outdoor-winter-en adventure producten, aan klanten die het hele jaar door actief onderweg zijn. We zijn nog maar net vertrokken, versterken onze positie in Nederland en tevens zetten we de eerste stappen richting Europa. Onze ambities? Groot. We willen op toonaangevende marketplaces zoals Amazon, Bol en Decathlon echt zichtbaar worden. Daarbij kan jij een cruciale rol gaan vervullen. Als Marketplace Specialist til jij onze performance naar een hoger niveau. Jij zorgt ervoor dat onze producten niet alleen gezien worden, maar ook verkocht en gekocht worden. Je optimaliseert listings, stuurt op voorraad en pricing, en duikt in data om commerciële kansen te spotten en te pakken. Van content tot conversie, jij weet wat werkt. Samen met onze marketing, product, customer service en operations zorg je ervoor dat we groeien: nieuwe producten ontwikkelen, nieuwe markten aanboren, nieuwe kansen zoeken en vinden. Jouw impact moet direct zichtbaar worden binnen ons gezamenlijke resultaat. Taken Beheren en optimaliseren van listings op diverse marktplaatsen, inclusief titels, beschrijvingen, beelden, SEO en pricing. Monitoren van prestaties (traffic, conversie, ranking, retourpercentages) en gericht optimaliseren op basis van data). Aansturen en verbeteren van de productinformatievoorziening in samenwerking met product management. Opzetten en beheren van campagnes binnen marktplaatsplatformen (advertising, deals, promoties). Bewaken van voorraadposities, levertijden en order control processen. Analyseren van concurrentie en marktkansen om groei te versnellen. Signaleren van trends en kansen binnen marketplaces en proactief initiatieven voorstellen. Oplossen van operationele issues zoals listing errors, account health en klantvragen. Rapporteren van resultaten en verbeterkansen. Vereisten Je hebt ervaring met marketplaces (Bol, Amazon of vergelijkbare platformen). Ervaring met bijv. Channable, EffectConnect of vergelijkbare systemen is een plus. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent analytisch sterk en handelt doelgericht. Je weet commerciële kansen te herkennen én benutten. Je hebt affiniteit met e-commerce, productdata en conversieoptimalisatie. Je communiceert helder en werkt graag samen met verschillende afdelingen. Je bent fulltime 40 uur beschikbaar. Benefits Een plek in een ervaren team, waar iedereen iets toevoegt. Succes maak je samen. Jezelf ontwikkelen en steeds uit blijven dagen. Uitzicht op een vast contract bij goed functioneren. Collega’s waarbij teamwork en collegialiteit van groot belang zijn. Een goed salaris op basis van kennis en ervaring. 25 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime werkweek. Reiskostenvergoeding à € 0.23, – per km (maximaal 40 km een enkele reis). Informele werksfeer met vrijdagmiddagborrels, personeelsfeest en kerstborrel. Op vrijdag sluiten we de week af met een drankje in onze eigen bar. Waarom je bij ons wilt werken Sluit je aan als Marketplace Specialist en word onderdeel van onze digitale groei-ambities. We zijn geen corporate met eindeloze overleggen, bij ons draait het om doen. Je komt terecht in een hands-on team dat niet bang is om te experimenteren, te leren en snel te schakelen. We bouwen aan merken die internationaal steeds meer terrein winnen. De komende jaren schalen we op in meerdere Europese markten: Duitsland, België, Oostenrijk en verder. Jij speelt daar een sleutelrol in. Je krijgt de vrijheid om processen te professionaliseren, strategieën uit te testen en échte impact te maken op onze marketplace-performance. Denk aan: optimaliseren van productfeeds, experimenteren met pricing-strategieën, A/B-testen van content, en het opzetten van campagnes die converteren. Dit is geen standaard 9-tot-5 job waar je vastloopt in procedures. Je werkt nauw samen met marketing, product en operations, en je ideeën worden serieus genomen. Zie je een kans? Dan pak je 'm. Spot je een probleem? Dan los je het op. Jouw impact is direct zichtbaar in onze cijfers en daar worden we allemaal enthousiast van. Ready to join? Ben je klaar om mee te bouwen aan een merk met internationale ambitie? Iemand die niet alleen wil uitvoeren, maar ook wil meedenken over waar we naartoe gaan? Stuur ons je CV en vertel in je motivatie waarom jij dé persoon bent die onze marketplace-strategie naar het volgende niveau tilt. We maken graag persoonlijk kennis, zonder corporate gedoe, gewoon een goed gesprek over hoe jij een sleutelrol kunt spelen in onze Europese expansie. En wie weet zit je over een paar weken al midden in je eerste marketplace-optimalisatie. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow
